detail.longDescription: I think the scariest and craziest thing about # AI now is that as a game developer or web developer, you can never be sure you’re not using it. Like unless you design and code every single asset, code library/framework and third party resource, how would you know for sure? My mod doesn’t use AI as of this point, but I’ll never be able to know whether future third party assets did… # gamedev # webdev
